results.snippet: The most recent change came from underground. In November 2011 the Soraz refinery came into service, some fifty kilometres north of the city, to process crude from the country's eastern block. It was the region's biggest industrial investment in decades and reoriented part of the local economy, with the usual effects: jobs, heavy traffic and sensitive infrastructure that is not to be photographed.
